name: anteater-mcp
description: UCI course discovery and degree planning using Anteater API. Handles only public UCI course data and stores no personal data. Not an official UCI service. Runs over stdio; includes Node 24 in the launch command.

ANTEATER_API_KEY.description: Optional Anteater API secret key. Empty uses anonymous quota. Use separate shared and personal Hub entries for a team.

examples.title: Course discovery
examples.prompt: Find UCI courses about machine learning.
